releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.11 (Build 88):
• Zero-Lag Route Architecture: Removed dual-DOM route slide transitions and frozen outlets so every tab and page switches instantaneously without hanging or stuck views.
• Zero-Blur Liquid Glass Optics: Eliminated residual GPU backdrop-filter and CSS blur passes across navigation dock, cards, and modals while fixing the dock droplet inner hairline.
• Hardware-Aware Performance Engine: Added real-time RAM, CPU core, GPU, and storage tier classification with adaptive smoothness controls in Settings.
• Non-Blocking Local Persistence: Replaced double synchronous full-state localStorage JSON writes on every tap with idle-batched writes and safe pagehide flushes.
• Snappier Bottom Dock & Controls: Removed layoutId thrashing, blocking mode="wait" exits, and artificial rAF tap delays across TabBar, Calendar, Timetable, and Gym.
• Luna AI Full Upgrade (Phases 1-12): Provider-independent AI gateway, bounded conversation summaries, privacy-scoped note RAG, controllable user memory, validated actions, and 6 domain prompts.
